name: matching-tool-community
description: Local-first Community reconciliation — private development candidate

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json && cd web && npx vite build
scripts.test: npm run test:app && npm run test:node
scripts.test:smoke: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/demo-http-smoke.test.mjs tests/community-smoke.e2e.mjs tests/community-account-server.test.mjs tests/matching-review.browser.e2e.mjs tests/community-account-browser.e2e.mjs tests/community-launcher.test.mjs tests/community-financial-browser.e2e.mjs
scripts.test:policy: node --test tests/i18n.test.mjs tests/migration-gate.test.mjs tests/synthetic-migration.test.mjs tests/offline-legacy-import.test.mjs tests/legacy-migration-evolution.test.mjs tests/privacy-scanner.test.mjs
